description: ACI 349-0C Nuclear Structures - Anchorage - Physical Experiment Database is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Benjamin Worsfold, University of Minnesota (umn.edu). This project presents experimental datasets from multiple research laboratories and testing programs contributed by members of the American Concrete Institute Committee 349-0C on Nuclear Structures - Anchorage. The collection addresses the need for high-quality experimental data to calibrate, and validate computational models of concrete anchorage behavior and failure mechanisms. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: concrete anchorage, experimental data. Published 2026-09-10. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
